Somewhere past the fern belt

The Moss Moon Field Guide

A pppocket-sized report from a tiny green moon where the mushrooms glow, the rivers hum, and one very small frog runs the weather station.

☼ 18° and pleasantly spore-y

Three things we found

All harmless. Probably.

Lantern mushroom

Gives excellent light and unsolicited advice about clouds.

Pocket comet

Fits in a teacup. Keeps asking for directions to Saturn.

Weather frog

Predicts rain by staring thoughtfully at a pebble.

Today's extremely scientific inventory.
